name: PropStream
shortDescription: Property search with an AI search box. Essentials is $99 per month.
longDescription: PropStream searches property records and includes an AI search and a PropStream Intelligence Assistant. PropStream's own cost article, read October 16, 2026, lists Essentials at $99 per month, Pro at $199, and Elite at $699, with a 7-day trial and 50 leads.
pricingNotes: Essentials $99 per month, Pro $199, Elite $699, from PropStream's cost article. 7-day trial.
bestFor: Searching properties with filters and an AI search box during a 7-day trial
notIdealFor: Someone who wants a free ongoing subscription
strength: PropStream's cost article lists Essentials at $99 per month, and the site offers a 7-day trial.
weakness: The trial is 7 days, and skip tracing and mail are add-on costs beyond the subscription.

useCaseFit.find-land: Searches property records with an AI search box, and Essentials is $99 per month.
useCaseFit.find-off-market: Filters property records, including off-market search, and Essentials is $99 per month.
useCaseFit.rank-property-deals: Filters property records, including off-market ones.
useCaseFit.real-estate: Searches property records, including off-market listings, from one set of filters.
